notes: Upgraded after the network opened at about 14:07 UTC using direct fetches. Elections are run by the District & County Clerk, Mozelle Carr. The clerk's elections page (lovingcountyanddistrictclerk.com/elections-1, fetch_module hash 073fc290...) lists election notices, order of election, sample ballots, precinct maps, poll worker and EVBB notices and campaign finance reports, and refers voters to the Texas Secretary of State, but posts no election results documents of any kind (no unofficial, cumulative, precinct or canvass reports). The county site page co.loving.tx.us/page/loving.County.Clerk (hash 01b22317...) also has no results link and points to the clerk website. results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Loving/elections.json returns 404 (no Clarity site). Why low confidence: this is evidence of absence as of 2026-10-02; results could have been shared another way on election night (e.g. posted at the courthouse or removed later), and no source states explicitly that results are available only through the SOS. platform set to sos_feed_only to match the tag; no county results host exists to record. Contact: clerk elections page reads 'Phone: (432) 309-9500 Ext. #6 Fax: 432-789-2194 Election Main Email: Elections@lovingcounty.org'; the SOS Election Duties list (hash 065e1ebd...) gives LOVING COUNTY District & County Clerk Mary Mozelle Carr, (432) 309-9500 ext. 6, County Email Address mailto:lovingea@co.loving.tx.us (alternate email). Usage notice: none. Stated change: none found. Wayback: wayback_probe (3 CDX windows) failed robots_disallowed_or_unreachable; no availability queries run for Loving. Work paused by the orchestrator before any further checks.
tag_rationale: The county clerk's elections page, fetched directly, carries no election results documents for any election, and no vendor results site exists, so results appear to be available only through the SOS; this rests on absence of evidence, hence low confidence.
